whole_board.protocol: Serial processes, six CPU profiles at 4 workers; full 160-cell planted cases for30s; original cases for60s with paired seeds71/197 and reversed CPU-profile order on second pass; CUDA512lanes two60s repeats. Imported identical unrestricted root for every profile. The GPU domain search is deterministic, so GPU seeds are repetitions, not independent random policies.
